info.title: vproxy management API
info.description: API for the separately configured management HTTPS listener. Browser administration uses a process-local session cookie; mutations also require the exact configured Origin, application/json and CSRF. users:read Bearer permits only two local user-read resources; schema 18 users:write also permits caller-bound non-secret local user operations and context, never credentials or remote control. Never mix Authorization with Cookie or CSRF, and never send Proxy-Authorization. Bearer may omit Origin but a supplied value must exactly match the configured HTTPS origin. Proxy listeners and the exact-DER node mTLS protocol are separate interfaces. A saved policy, an applied policy and a successful client test are different results. Disconnect, timeout or 5xx can follow a committed mutation: reconcile a durable operation or command before deciding what to do next.

servers.description: Use the configured management authority and normally verified CA/SAN. This is not a proxy port or the separate node listener.

x-vproxy-limits.note: Limits are wire-byte limits, including JSON escapes. A request deadline or cancelled HTTP waiter does not cancel a dispatched storage mutation.

post.description: Requires an existing local administrator. A valid login replaces the supplied old session if any; no bootstrap or default account exists. Password verification is bounded and rate limited. Session lifetime is eight hours and restart invalidates all sessions. Do not send Authorization or Proxy-Authorization. Store Cookie and csrf_token privately; neither is a proxy credential.

get.description: The cookie must belong to this running process. Missing or expired browser sessions produce 403, not a Basic or Bearer challenge.

Set-Cookie.description: Expires this session cookie with Max-Age=0

post.description: Rechecks current_password and the request's session. All sessions for this administrator are revoked once the mutation fence is entered, even after a confirmed conflict or rollback; other administrators remain independent. A password_change_outcome_unknown or request timeout must not be blindly retried. No target administrator or node is accepted from JSON.

204.description: Password changed; session cookie expired; log in again

Set-Cookie.description: Expires this session cookie with Max-Age=0

get.summary: Read this management process's node identity
get.description: The response does not claim a public server IP, egress IP, proxy readiness or current IP health.

Session.name: __Host-vproxy-session
Session.description: Process-local administrator session from login. Not a proxy login, node identity or automation grant. Do not combine it with Authorization.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: csrf_token from the same live session; required together with the Session cookie for administrator mutations.

Automation.description: Locally issued users:read or users:write identity. users:write includes user reads plus caller-bound non-secret user operations and context on schema 18. No OAuth endpoint, Cookie/CSRF mixing, Proxy-Authorization, credentials, IPAM, presets, ownership or remote control. A supplied Origin must exactly match the configured HTTPS origin; it may be absent.

UserOperationOrigin.name: Origin
UserOperationOrigin.description: Required with Session/CSRF authentication. Optional with Automation; if supplied it must exactly match the configured canonical management HTTPS origin. Host and JSON validation still apply.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exactly the configured canonical management HTTPS origin, without path or trailing slash.

PageAfter.name: after
PageAfter.description: ID cursor from this same legacy resource and options. Ordinary pages are not a coherent cross-request snapshot. Not interchangeable with a search cursor.

PageLimit.name: limit
PageLimit.description: Canonical decimal 1..50, without leading zero. Unknown or duplicate query fields are rejected.

IncludeDeleted.name: include_deleted
IncludeDeleted.description: Only the literal true or false. Deleted IDs remain historical and cannot be reactivated.

Error.description: Fixed public error code; no storage, verifier or remote-body diagnostics. Codes and HTTP status must be considered together. Common failures include invalid input/query (400), invalid or absent Bearer credentials (401), session/CSRF or authorization denial and insufficient_scope (403), missing resource (404), conflict (409), body timeout/size/media type (408/413/415), rate limit (429), internal failure (500), remote failure (502) and busy/upgrade/unavailable/request timeout (503). Only the Bearer-capable local user reads and user-operation resources send authentication challenges. A transport error, timeout or 5xx is not proof that a mutation did not commit.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Only on Bearer-capable resources: Bearer realm="vproxy"; invalid_token on invalid/revoked/expired credentials, invalid_request on malformed/mixed authentication, or insufficient_scope with scope="users:write" after a valid key lacks write authority (RFC 6750 section 3.1). Absent on Cookie-only resources.

Retry-After.description: 60 on HTTP 429. This header is not permission to replay a possibly committed mutation.

Id.description: Canonical base64url without padding of a generated 128-bit identity. Never a display name or a proxy login.

Revision.description: Canonical decimal integer 1..9223372036854775807. Parse exactly, never through a floating-point Number. The upper bound is enforced by the API in addition to this lexical schema.

Sequence.description: Canonical decimal integer 0..9223372036854775807; zero means no terminal command where the resource says so. Keep distinct from a positive revision.

Counter.description: Canonical decimal u64, 0..18446744073709551615. Preserve as string or exact big integer. The server also enforces the numeric upper bound.

Name.description: Nonempty trimmed name, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, with no Unicode control characters. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters; the API separately checks the UTF-8 byte bound.

Protocol.description: User permission: http also covers HTTPS transport. This is distinct from the listener's protocol selector.

login.description: Generated base proxy login; unrelated to a display name or administrator. Extensions are applied by the connection generator.

UserPage.description: Ascending IDs, exclusive after cursor. Rows cannot exceed the page revision. next_cursor is null or the last row ID of a full page. Ordinary list pagination is not a cross-page snapshot.

CredentialPage.description: Metadata only, never a secret or verifier. Ascending IDs and exclusive after cursor; not a cross-page snapshot.

secret.description: Creation or rotation returns the newly issued proxy secret. Lists and operation replay never return it. Schema28 supports a separate explicit read of the selected current encrypted copy; legacy one-way credentials have no recoverable copy.

PolicyChange.description: Result of a legacy direct user/credential mutation. Fields irrelevant to the action are null. revision is saved policy state, not proof of runtime application or client reachability.

password.description: Existing administrator password, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters. Do not put it in command arguments or logs.

new_password.description: At least 12 Unicode scalar values, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters. Leading/trailing spaces are preserved.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds for display. The server enforces expiry with a monotonic clock, not a caller-supplied timestamp.
